correct_query: SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE CUSTOMER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE PRODUCT_NAME = 'A') AND CUSTOMER_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE PRODUCT_NAME = 'B') AND CUSTOMER_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE PRODUCT_NAME = 'C') ORDER BY CUSTOMER_ID

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME FROM CUSTOMERS C JOIN ORDERS O ON (C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID) GROUP BY C.CUSTOMER_ID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_NAME = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_NAME = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_NAME = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0

schema: CREATE TABLE CUSTOMERS ( CUSTOMER_ID INT, CUSTOMER_NAME VARCHAR(255), PRIMARY KEY (CUSTOMER_ID) ); CREATE TABLE ORDERS ( ORDER_ID INT, CUSTOMER_ID int, PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255), PRIMARY KEY (ORDER_ID), FOREIGN KEY (CUSTOMER_ID) REFERENCES CUSTOMERS(CUSTOMER_ID) );
